trailhead.label: Baita Monte Pat car park above Montesover, the APT’s start

cautions: A forest road open to farm and forestry vehicles.
Cows graze the pastures round Malga Vernera in summer: keep your dog on the lead and give the herd room.
A steady climb of about 180 m.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
